name: TC-CL-03: Check Truck Price lead form rejects mobile that is not 10 digits on 14 Wheeler
fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/CategoryPages/CategoryListingWheelers.cy.js#CategoryPages - CategoryListing [fourteenWheeler] [en] — 14 Wheeler TC-CL-03: Check Truck Price lead form rejects mobile that is not 10 digits on 14 Wheeler
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-CL-03
**Title:** Check Truck Price lead form rejects mobile that is not 10 digits on 14 Wheeler
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Open the 14 Wheeler page, open Check Truck Price, fill a valid name, an invalid (5-digit) mobile number, and leave city empty, then submit.

**Expected Result:**
The real, page-shown mobile-format and location-required validation messages are displayed, and no lead is submitted.

**Steps:**
1. Open the 14 Wheeler page
2. Click a truck card's "Check Truck Price" button to open its lead form
3. Fill a valid name and an invalid mobile number
4. Submit with city left empty
5. Verify the mobile-format and location validation messages are shown
